Every document valid under 1.3.0 still validates. PRIOR: 1.2.0 -> 1.3.0 (enum-value-additive) adds `next_action.kind: terminal_commit`: a chain halted after its execute child returned names `dispatch.terminal_commit` with open params that must carry `script_path` and `task_output_path`. The plan triple moves into the `execute` branch unchanged, so every document valid under 1.2.0 still validates. RE-VENDOR: claude-klabauter-24 switches the chain driver to fill it. PRIOR: 1.1.0 -> 1.2.0 (nested-field-additive) widens `next_action.op`/`params` from null to string-or-null / object-or-null: a ready `plan` digest names the chain's logical op `plan_chain.run` and its params {plan_path, sizing_object, deliverable_id}; `kind: none` keeps both null. Every document valid under 1.1.0 still validates. PRIOR: 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 (nested-field-additive) declares the optional `chain` block (stages_run, halted_at, halt_reason, commit) the sizing-to-commit chain writes into its final digest. Every document valid under 1.0.0 still validates.
title: DoE wake digest
description: The code-assembled digest for the two turns DoE assembles itself: `plan` (planDigest, turn 2) and `close` (workstream-complete's Final Summary, turn 4). Named apart from the engine repo's execute digest so two different contracts never share a filename; the execute digest is validated against the engine repo coordinator_core/contract/wake-digest.schema.json at HEAD 9403b9a638f4a985a374235f15381e4d7e5975c3, never restated here. Field names and caps follow that file's Design D1 table wherever they overlap (`criterion`, `decision_required`, `em_may_think_differently`, `deviations`'s per-item shape), per docs/plans/2026-09-27-four-turn-em-loop.md § Pinned interfaces. Two named differences from the execute digest: `em_may_think_differently`/`overflow` are top-level here, not nested under `review`; and `deviations` items are `{line, anchor}`, not `{chunk, kind, anchor}`, because a plan or close digest has no executed chunk to name.

chain.description: Optional: present only when the engine drove a sizing-to-commit chain. A digest without it is an in-session run. A non-null `halted_at` means the chain stopped before committing, so `commit` is null.

next_action.description: `kind: none` carries null `op`/`params`. `kind: execute` (a ready `plan` digest) names the chain's logical op `plan_chain.run`, realized as the engine CLI `plan-chain-run`, with its params. `kind: terminal_commit` (a chain halted after its execute child returned) names `dispatch.terminal_commit` with the params to run unedited: the execute digest's own params plus `script_path` and `task_output_path`.
